items.title: 2.3 Logic as a Knowledge Representation Framework

source_refs.note: Topic 2.3 with its Tidbit, the headings Logic in Computer Science and Role of Logic in Reasoning and Decision Making, and the Class Activity printed at the top of the next page, as printed (PDF 26-27, printed 22-23).

blocks.text: Logic is the science of true reasoning and is an important concept in computer science. It helps computers store, understand, and use information correctly. Using logic, complex information can be represented in a simple way.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Logic gives computers a way to “think” about facts and make decisions, almost like a brain.

In computer science, logic means using rules to make correct decisions. Logic helps computers understand true and false conditions. It allows systems to process information correctly. Logical statements are used in programs and algorithms. These statements help control the flow of programs. Logic is the basis of many computer operations. It helps computers think in a structured way.
Role of Logic in Reasoning and Decision Making

Logic plays an important role in reasoning and decision making. It helps computers and humans draw correct conclusions. Using logic, decisions are made based on facts and rules. It removes confusion and guesswork. Logical reasoning helps solve problems step by step. Computers use logic to choose the correct action. Logic ensures that decisions are consistent and accurate. It is used in expert systems and artificial intelligence.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
• Discuss how logic helps in making decisions.
• Students make simple “if-then” statements about school life.
• Example: “If it rains, then we will stay indoors.”
